text_block_list.text:
It happened while walking down the hallway.
A haughty laugh echoed out from the dance studio...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho!
Come, we're not nearly finished yet!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I shall display a first-rate dance at the ball
that will never bring shame to the name of King!
Wait right thereee!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
When you say ball, you think masks,
masquerade, which means—El!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
El-san?!
What are you doing so suddenly—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
King Young Lady... no, King!
El challenges you to a showdown!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
On my Latin blood!
I'll show you what I'm made of through dance, ssssiiiii!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
'Show me what you're made of'...
Why are you even challenging me to begin with?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And besides, if you want a dance battle,
that outfit isn't for dancing at all, is it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's the passionate Condor Monk outfit, though?
It's my racewear, you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho!
Save the jokes and go to a wrestling ring where you belong.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're not even worth entertaining.
Now, kindly allow me to continue my lesson.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—'A duel between noble ladies
is settled not through brawling, but through dance.'

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...That's what a certain first-rate person told me
back when we had a dance battle~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was dressed like this back then too, but she took on the challenge
without batting an eye~

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Man, is that what you call true grace and composure?
I thought to myself, 'Now that's truly first-rate!'~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Composure... you say?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Guess King doesn't have that first-rate composure after all~

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And here I thought you were first-rate, what a disappointment!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat—?!
Hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Very well, I shall show you.
I'll prove to you that I possess plenty of first-rate composure!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Now that's what I'm talking abooouuut!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You over there, act as our referee!
Make sure to state clearly which of us is superior!
Overwhelmed by their bizarre intensity, I inadvertently nodded.

Classical and Latin music blasted simultaneously,
and the dance battle commenced.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Gnuuuuuh!
I won't let anyone call me Snow Konggg!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea what that analogy means, but... ugh,
what incredible tenacity... damn it!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Deryaaaaah!!
Haaaaaaaah!!

Even as night fell completely, neither of them stopped.
In the first place, there was no way to settle a match between a waltz and a mambo...
If it's come to this...!
If it's come to this...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?
What are you doing all of a sudden?
choice_data_list: I suddenly felt like dancing too!
I suddenly felt like dancing too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Looks like El's passion
has set your dancing spirit ablaze!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...King.
You truly live up to calling yourself first-rate.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph! But of course!
I suppose I can acknowledge your enthusiasm as well.

Acknowledging each other's fiery passion for dance,
the heated dance battle came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Sheesh, what time do you think it is?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Wah, Hishi Ama-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your enthusiasm,
but please don't make us worry, okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fuji-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I am terribly sorry, we will return immediately.

And so, the match ended in a draw,
and accompanied by their respective dorm heads,
they staggered exhausted all the way back.
